body: Sikorsky, a Lockheed Martin company, has been selected to supply S-92A+ helicopters to the Republic of Korea Air Force (ROKAF) under South Korea's Presidential Helicopter II program. The selection covers four helicopters; Lockheed Martin has not disclosed the contract value or a delivery schedule. South Korea has allocated approximately 873 billion won ($643 million) to the broader procurement program, according to local reporting, and the program runs through 2031, when the ROKAF is expected to begin replacing its existing presidential helicopters. The overall budget should not be confused with the value of Sikorsky's contract. Wonik Lee, Lockheed Martin's country executive for South Korea, stressed that the selection reflected the two countries' longstanding defense partnership and industrial cooperation, highlighting KAEMS' participation in the program.

Beyond the aircraft themselves, Sikorsky will provide special mission equipment and sustainment support, including critical spare parts and field service representatives. Korea Aviation Engineering & Maintenance Service (KAEMS), a subsidiary of Korea Aerospace Industries (KAI), will handle mission equipment installation in South Korea. The ROKAF took delivery of three S-92 helicopters in 2007 and has used them for presidential transport ever since. Other South Korean government operators also fly the type: the Korea Coast Guard uses the S-92 for search and rescue, while the National 119 Rescue Headquarters, part of the National Fire Agency, operates it for firefighting and rescue missions. The S-92 also serves as the basis for the US Marine Corps' VH-92A Patriot presidential helicopter; the Marine Corps accepted the 23rd and final VH-92A in August 2024, and the type carried President Joe Biden as Marine One for the first time on August 19, 2024.

According to Lockheed Martin, the S-92A+ features upgraded engines, a new Phase IV main gearbox, and increased payload or fuel capacity when compared with earlier S-92 variants. The upgraded GE CT7-8A6 engines and structural reinforcements increase the helicopter's maximum gross weight to 27,700 pounds (12,565 kilograms), enabling it to carry an additional 1,200 pounds (544 kilograms) of payload or fuel, and the Phase IV gearbox auxiliary lubrication system is designed to allow the helicopter to complete a flight safely following a loss of primary oil pressure. Sikorsky announced preparations for its first S-92A+ production batch in March 2026, following an order for two aircraft from an unnamed country for head-of-state transport; the initial batch was to comprise the two helicopters plus three additional aircraft. The company claims to be ramping up production in Stratford, Connecticut, and Owego, New York, with capacity for up to 12 S-92A+ helicopters annually. According to Lockheed Martin, the global S-92 fleet has accumulated more than 2.6 million flight hours, with over 300 helicopters delivered to operators in 28 countries.
en.summary: Sikorsky, a Lockheed Martin company, has been selected to supply four S-92A+ helicopters to the Republic of Korea Air Force under the Presidential Helicopter II program, a broader procurement budgeted at about 873 billion won and running through 2031, when the new aircraft are expected to replace S-92s delivered in 2007.

body: 塞考斯基已獲選為大韓民國空軍供應S-92A+直升機，納入韓國總統直升機二期計畫；此次選定涵蓋四架直升機，洛克希德·馬丁未公布合約金額與交付時程。據當地報導，韓國已為整體採購計畫編列約8,730億韓元（約6.43億美元）預算，計畫執行至2031年，屆時空軍預計開始汰換現役總統直升機；此整體預算不應與塞考斯基的合約金額混為一談。洛克希德·馬丁韓國區主管Wonik Lee表示，此次選定反映韓美長久的國防夥伴關係與產業合作，並特別提到KAEMS參與計畫。

除直升機本身外，塞考斯基將提供特種任務裝備與後勤支援，包括關鍵備件與派駐現場的服務代表；韓國航空宇宙產業子公司韓國航空工程維修服務公司（KAEMS）將在韓國境內負責任務裝備安裝。韓國空軍於2007年接收三架S-92直升機，此後一直用於總統專機任務；韓國海洋警察廳亦使用S-92執行搜救，國家消防廳119救援本部則用於消防與救援。S-92亦是美國海軍陸戰隊VH-92A總統直升機的基礎機型；陸戰隊於2024年8月接收第23架、也是最後一架VH-92A，該機型同月19日首度搭載時任總統拜登以海軍陸戰隊一號身分飛行。

S-92A+換裝升級版發動機與新型第四階段主變速箱，有效載荷或燃油容量均較早期S-92提升。升級後的GE CT7-8A6發動機與結構強化使最大總重增至27,700磅（12,565公斤），可多攜帶1,200磅（544公斤）有效載荷或燃油；第四階段變速箱的輔助潤滑系統設計可在主油壓失效後仍讓直升機安全完成飛行。塞考斯基於2026年3月宣布為首批S-92A+量產做準備，此前接獲某未具名國家兩架元首專機訂單，首批共五架，包括該兩架與另外三架；公司表示正於康乃狄克州Stratford與紐約州Owego擴大生產，年產能最高12架。全球S-92機隊累計飛行時數已逾260萬小時，向28個國家交付逾300架。
zh.summary: 洛克希德·馬丁旗下塞考斯基獲選為韓國空軍總統直升機二期計畫供應四架S-92A+直升機，整體計畫預算約8,730億韓元、執行至2031年，屆時將汰換2007年交付的舊型S-92總統專機。
zh.title: 韓國選定四架S-92A+直升機擔任總統專機，2031年前汰換舊機
